title: Atlas SDK 1.4 retry policy
summary: Atlas SDK 1.4 retries a failed request three times by default and permits a per-client override.
content: For Atlas SDK releases in the 1.x line, the default retry count is three. A client may override this setting. This statement does not describe Atlas SDK 2.0.

title: Atlas SDK 2.0 release notes
summary: Atlas SDK 2.0 changes the default retry count from three to five while pinned 1.x clients remain at three.
content: Version 2.0 changes the automatic retry default to five attempts. Existing clients pinned to the 1.x series retain the old default of three attempts.

title: Atlas connection timeout configuration
summary: Atlas clients use a 30 second connection timeout unless the client configuration overrides it.
content: The default connection timeout is 30 seconds. Retry count and connection timeout are separate client settings.

title: Orchid reranking on OQ-Short
summary: With reranking enabled, Orchid improves OQ-Short Recall@10 from 0.62 to 0.71.
content: The reported OQ-Short experiment uses reranking. Recall at ten rises from 0.62 for the baseline to 0.71 for Orchid. OQ-Long was not evaluated in this paper.

title: Independent Orchid long-document replication
summary: An independent replication measures Orchid at 0.48 versus a 0.51 baseline on OQ-Long.
content: We independently reproduced the short-document result. On the long-document OQ-Long benchmark, Orchid scored 0.48 Recall@10 and the baseline scored 0.51.

title: Orchid launch announcement
summary: The vendor says Orchid improves retrieval across short and long documents.
content: Our launch announcement claims better retrieval quality for both short and long documents. It does not provide the OQ-Long measurements used by the independent replication.

title: Northstar deadline newsletter
summary: A newsletter states that Northstar proposals are due June 15 at 17:00 UTC.
content: The newsletter lists the Northstar proposal deadline as June 15, 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

title: Original Northstar 2026 portal notice
summary: The original portal displayed June 15 at 17:00 China Standard Time, UTC+8.
content: The portal initially displayed a deadline of June 15 at 17:00 China Standard Time (UTC+8). This display was later identified as erroneous.

title: Official Northstar deadline correction
summary: The official correction says the deadline is June 15 at 17:00 UTC and retracts the earlier UTC+8 display.
content: Correction: the portal displayed the wrong time zone. The authoritative Northstar 2026 proposal deadline is June 15 at 17:00 UTC. The earlier UTC+8 display is retracted.

title: Cedar v3 cache invalidation reference
summary: Cedar client v3 invalidates a cached record when its revision token changes.
content: A change to a record revision token invalidates the corresponding Cedar client v3 cache entry.

title: Independent Cedar 3.1 cache test
summary: An independent Cedar 3.1 test observed the next read bypassing cache after a revision-token change.
content: Our test changed a revision token in Cedar 3.1 and observed that the next read bypassed the cached value. The observation was produced by our own test procedure.

title: Repost of Cedar cache documentation
summary: A mirror repeats that revision-token changes invalidate cached records and reports no independent test.
content: Documentation says a cached Cedar record is invalidated whenever its revision token changes. This article is a rewritten repost and contains no independent observation.

title: Cedar CDN edge-cache TTL
summary: Cedar's public CDN uses a ten minute edge-cache TTL for static assets.
content: Static assets at the Cedar CDN edge expire after a ten minute time-to-live. This is unrelated to Cedar client record revision tokens.

title: Route B strict 500 metre sampling capacity
summary: Strict 500 metre thinning may produce fewer than 8,000 weak samples because spatial capacity is limited.
content: Keep the quality thresholds fixed. If strict 500 m separation cannot reach 8,000 samples, report the shortfall as a spatial-capacity limit rather than duplicating points or lowering thresholds.

title: Route B fixed manual calibration rows
summary: The current Route B v2 branches retain 301 manual calibration samples as training and calibration data.
content: All current cold-start branches keep the fixed 301 manually calibrated rows. They are not an independent validation set in this round.

title: Sentinel-2 seasonal17 feature stack
summary: The seasonal17 stack uses seasonal Sentinel-2 features in the frozen Route B v1 random-forest pipeline.
content: The frozen method ends with a seasonal17 random forest. The seasonal feature stack is designed to retain phenological information from multiple Sentinel-2 observations.

title: Python free-threaded runtime note
summary: A free-threaded Python build can disable the global interpreter lock, but extension compatibility must be checked.
content: Free-threaded builds permit execution without the global interpreter lock. This does not make every existing extension automatically thread-safe.

title: Python pyproject build isolation
summary: PEP 517 frontends create an isolated environment for declared build-system requirements.
content: Build-system requirements belong in pyproject.toml. A compliant frontend installs those requirements into an isolated build environment before invoking the backend.

title: Kubernetes liveness probe behavior
summary: Repeated liveness probe failure causes kubelet to restart the container according to its restart policy.
content: A liveness probe detects a stuck container. After the configured failure threshold, kubelet restarts that container.

title: Kubernetes startup probe behavior
summary: A startup probe delays liveness and readiness checks until slow application startup succeeds.
content: When a startup probe is configured, liveness and readiness probes do not begin until startup succeeds. This protects slow-starting applications from premature restarts.

title: Curated-source memory for personal agents
summary: A user can teach an agent preferences by deliberately saving high-quality sources with provenance.
content: Instead of treating every conversation as durable memory, the user deliberately selects high-quality articles, papers, and notes. The selected evidence and its provenance transmit the user's judgment and taste to the agent.

title: Automatic chat-history memory
summary: Automatic memory systems extract candidate facts from chat history without requiring explicit source collection.
content: The system observes conversations and automatically extracts user facts. This route optimizes passive capture rather than deliberate, source-backed curation.
